name: Nusantara Resources Limited
summary: Nusantara Resources Limited engages in the exploration, evaluation, and development of gold resources in Indonesia. It owns a 100% interest in the Awak Mas gold project located in South Sulawesi, Indonesia. The company was formerly known as Awak Mas Holdings Pty Ltd. and changed its name to Nusantara Resources Limited in February 2017. Nusantara Resources Limited is headquartered in West Perth, Australia.
